obAskName: First, what should I call you?
obAskDateNote: A solar or a lunar date both work.
obAskTimeNote: If you don't know the exact time, pick a two-hour period.
obAskCity: Which city were you born in?
obAskCityNote: 用来校正出生时间，不填也行。
It corrects the birth time for longitude. You can skip it.
obAskCityNoteShichen: 你给的是时辰，城市只作出生地记录，不填也行。
You gave a two-hour period, so the city is only kept as the birthplace. You can skip it.
obShiftCity: 按{city}（东经 {lon}°）校正后是 {solar}，落在{corrected}（钟表时间 {clock} 是{clockName}）
Corrected for {city} ({lon}°E), the time is {solar}, which falls in {corrected} (the clock time {clock} is in {clockName}).
obShiftLon: 按东经 {lon}° 校正后是 {solar}，落在{corrected}（钟表时间 {clock} 是{clockName}）
Corrected for {lon}°E, the time is {solar}, which falls in {corrected} (the clock time {clock} is in {clockName}).
obSameCity: Corrected for {city} ({lon}°E), the time is {solar}, still in {corrected}.
obSameLon: 按东经 {lon}° 校正后是 {solar}，仍是{corrected}
Corrected for {lon}°E, the time is {solar}, still in {corrected}.
obSolarOffNote: 按钟表时间 {clock} {clockName}排盘，不做真太阳时校正
Using the clock time {clock} ({clockName}), with no true solar time correction.
obShichenNote: 按{name}排盘，不做真太阳时校正
Using {name} as you gave it, with no true solar time correction.
obPhDate: 比如 1990年6月15日，或 农历1990年五月廿三
For example 1990-6-15, or a lunar date such as 农历1990年五月廿三
obPhTime: 比如 下午三点半、15:30、申时
obPhCity: A city name in Chinese, or a longitude
obNameTooLong: 称呼短一点，12 个字以内
Keep the name to 12 characters or fewer.
obCityUnknown: 没找到「{text}」。换个写法，或直接填经度（如 116.4）；也可以跳过
No match for "{text}". Try another spelling, enter a longitude (e.g. 116.4), or skip.
obCityProvince: 「{province}」是省，范围太大，定不了经度。选一个城市，或直接填经度
"{province}" is a province, too wide to set a longitude from. Pick a city or enter a longitude.
obLonRange: 经度要在 60 到 140 之间
The longitude must be between 60 and 140.
obQuickCities: 北京|上海|广州|深圳|成都|杭州|武汉|西安
